method: Prepared means the last prior independent sample covered the target, or its project already had a finished preview file. A join is prepared only if the primer and the frames on both sides of the boundary were prepared. Play uses the actual button timestamp. Before-primer uses play time minus observed primer duration and a 50ms guard. Cache sampling is approximately once per second. CPU is an OS process sample. Ordinals follow the native measurement order.

decodedOutputChecks.description: Rendered every corresponding completed native playback fragment to the same interleaved PCM representation and compared the complete byte stream and sample-PTS intervals. The FLAC playback path contains the encoded AAC edit audio resampled to S16. A separate graph probe compares the uncompressed original-picture/float-audio inputs before the lossy encoder.

firstExactPrimerRange.note: The optional direct float-to-S16 test harness differs at one bit with the unchanged engine as well as across arms. The original F32 mix sent to the native AAC encoder is identical in all three controls.

pausedScrubGuard.method: Matched randomized native paused seeks. Camera opens are counted in the actual foreground range graph, independent of measured timings. Repeated means at least two separate FFmpeg input seeks to the same 4K camera. Pixel or callback favors an independently captured matching picture if present, otherwise uses an exact native video callback. Quantiles are nearest-rank p95 and median of observed values.

shippingDecision: Rejected after the general paused-seek median regressed. All native playback, cache pressure, and output comparisons here describe a private experiment.
